answer: Proof-of-stake validates agent identity by requiring capital commitment, creating a steep ridge for attackers who must acquire enough tokens to influence consensus. Like a falcon monitoring a vast meadow, the protocol detects inconsistencies in sub-identities by linking reputation scores to locked collateral. This mechanism forces adversaries to bear the full cost of slashing if they attempt to deploy massive fake identities, effectively rendering Sybil attacks economically irrational and technically unsustainable.
